text: Implemented the first canonical pair-estimator slice: validated RigidOptimizerControl, immutable CompiledRigidPairEstimator, explicit RigidEstimatorWorkspace, full-affine allocation-free centroid initializer, runFrom warm starts, target-frame SE(3) coordinate search, fixed-domain Huber objective, overlap/support diagnostics, typed OptimizationReport termination, primitive Ravel rank-3 voxel access, and production ResamplingPlan candidate evaluation. Initial cross-platform compile passed. Focused JVM run passed translation recovery/determinism and typed failure cases; the oblique fixture exposed a test-design issue, so initializer evidence was separated from optimizer evidence.
